arguments.sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name, s.weight_kg, typeof(s.weight_kg) AS weight_type, s.height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad' AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.id IN (
    SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp
    JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE p.power_name = 'Flight'
  )

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS INTEGER) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND s.weight_kg > 0
  AND s.id IN (
      SELECT hp.hero_id
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE p.power_name = 'Flight'
  )
LIMIT 1
